items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: That was my first band. That's the band we made up. Me and my brother-in-law, my brother, and my brother's son, and Joe Baptiste, and old man Niles Ross on bass.

ctx.x: You and your brother-in-law got that? That's the first band?
